UNGP2011.ownBoundedParaphrase: The framework distinguishes public protection, corporate respect and remedy. A company should prevent or reduce impacts directly linked through business relationships; causing or contributing entails remediation cooperation. A direct link alone does not impose self-provided remediation. Corporate respect remains distinct from legal liability and is not erased by public inaction or donations.

actualFictionBoundary: Names, reports, performance figures and utilities are fictional classroom premises. Primary standards provide benchmarks, not proof of an actual firm violation or a particular national law.
